ocr.notes: The list of boxers (Joe Coburn, Tom Allen, Mike McCoole, Tom Kelly) is garbled in the transcript but clear in the image.

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat announced a sparring exhibition at Mozart Hall the next night, with Joe Coburn, Tom Allen, Mike McCoole and other boxers expected, and Coburn and Allen sparring the wind-up in ring costume.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'Daily Democrat', Sunday morning, April 24, 1870.

facts.fact: Allen was billed to spar the wind-up against Joe Coburn at a sparring exhibition at Mozart Hall, St. Louis, with Mike McCoole and Tom Kelly also expected

notes: Announcement only; 'to-morrow night' from Sunday April 24 is Monday April 25, 1870.
